## Problem and scope

The original #6031 merged at b514 before the later qualification-repair branch update. This PR carries the concrete repairs forward onto the real f8ea Resident / NoUpdate / Candidate integration and qualifies the resulting source separately.

Current published head: `2cd908b7e81336fcdf65e85bbebea3c427810d12`.
Repository tree: `75affc9bf846b98c56cc38e488eab2e0a207954c`.
The runtime and proof inputs are unchanged from formatting head `5ae3d5fe358dc01d9e94c5a38758685f0920328f`, tree `dabffe7ed9571c676d889975dc8f025f5ac4220d`, byte-identical to local validation commit `8cc82616acef3e57b5b81827cf268491901ad06a`. The final commit adds only the qualification originals. Every published tree and ordered-parent identity was read back before the expected-old-head ref update.

## Reviewable stages

1. Merge f8ea with the earlier abc64 four-file repair using both real parents. Preserve upstream's equivalent Holdout and unique witness fixes. Repair the invalid inline/array-of-tables TOML combination, exact witness field marker and Candidate authority sequence.
2. Name the actual Resident, grant, service, readiness and delivery receivers so the unchanged conservative caller verifier can resolve the real calls. No factory, invocation, scope, timeout or authority is added. All ten ordinary runtime `run` receivers are explicitly classified.
3. Format the changed source and bind existing exact guards and mutation needles to the same formatted code. Retain all repeated CURRENT checks, forbidden rules, caller tuples and privileged inventory.
4. Apply the complete original six-package formatter scope to the 43 remaining inherited files. Each Rust postimage was independently checked against formatting its exact preimage. Split this work into eight commits of 613 / 401 / 589 / 681 / 323 / 505 / 249 / 592 changed lines. Rebind exact source markers, keep the full completed-source receiver checks in each caller, and add two deletion negative controls.

The verifier and typed scanner, Cargo inputs, Bazel inputs, protocol deadlines, retries and permissions remain unchanged from f8ea.

## Validation of the frozen runtime and proof inputs

- Original source-closure command: **259 tests, PASS**, 68.803 seconds process wall time; clean source before and after.
- All **329 protected rows** and caller self-test: PASS; **425 caller boundaries** retained.
- Complete original Windows **six-package** `cargo fmt --check`, repository formatter and original exact blob-size policy: PASS. The 43 inherited format failures are repaired.
- Full caller on this exact formatted tree started at 2026-11-12 02:20:06 UTC and is **running** with the original complete scan and a 1 GiB process address-space limit. It has not produced a verifier result.
- The earlier b965 caller was explicitly interrupted to serialize resources; its empty output is retained and is not counted as PASS. The intermediate formatting checkpoint's two failed source checks and the corrected command-line invocation failure are also retained.
- Fresh exact-head hosted native, complete caller and blocking results are still required.

## Original runtime evidence and limits

On the earlier b514 source, shared native executed **1,314 cases: 1,296 passed and 18 failed**, with one retry for those failures. The original physical-corruption regression and three new witness tests each passed on their first attempt. GNU Bazel agentd independently reported **993 passed / 18 failed / 71 ignored**.

The original 7a6c physical-corruption failure occurred at the first read after corrupting bytes, **before** the test restored the original bytes. The repair's live-owner poison checks and later passing restore control do not establish persistent corruption memory across a new process or whole-system cold recovery.

The 18 remaining failures retain distinct evidence: explicit deadline failures, Selector uncertainty, Missing assertions without actual values, and lost-ACK / malformed-response controls. They are not all attributed to timeouts or debug crypto. Because f8ea changes runtime composition, any later profile experiment on this base is not a strict A/B comparison with b514. Cargo profile changes do not qualify Bazel.

Accepted complete ordinary **Adopt = 0**, complete ordinary **NoUpdate = 0**, and complete daemon-plus-Root **cold recovery = 0**. Resident late-delivery and Candidate readback are concrete components; the ordinary main / explicit Root entry, independent B and adoption route remain separate completion requirements.

The [qualification originals](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/tree/2cd908b7e81336fcdf65e85bbebea3c427810d12/qualification/learn-physical-current-ff41/20261112) are committed: **97 complete originals**, 13,104,431 raw bytes, 123 files. Deterministic gzip chunks preserve full original and compressed SHA-256 identities; every file was decoded and compared before commit and rechecked after the local disk warning. Original failed runs, JUnit, the 18-failure sets, exact source identities, failed intermediate source snapshots and #6018 final attempt-2 metadata are retained. No historical failure is replaced by a later result.
